_comment: Baby Name Oracle Payment Links whose paid sessions unlock the report (MDO-NAMES-PRICE (a), 2026-10-14). amount_cents is the link's list price; verify.js checks a session's amount_subtotal (before promo codes) against it, so MDOEARLY50 (50% off: total 150 on 300) is accepted. ~/mdo3d/staged/pricing/PRICING_GO.sh fills the __...__ placeholders from out/new_ids.json before deploy; an entry whose id is not a plink_ id is ignored. The old link stays active in Stripe (never paused), so its buyers keep getting their report.
